claim_assertions.annual_fcf_increased: FY2025 free cash flow exceeded FY2024 free cash flow on the issuer definition.
claim_assertions.foa_income_covers_rl_loss: FY2025 Family of Apps operating income exceeds the absolute Reality Labs operating loss.
claim_assertions.tax_adjustment_future_cash_identifiable: The supplied cash-flow statement identifies the exact future cash-tax saving caused by its deferred-tax adjustment.

definitions.cash_model: months=3 denotes Q4, months=9 the first nine months and months=12 the fiscal year. Spending and lease principal are positive outflow amounts. FCF less net income is a difference of period flows.
definitions.operating_cash_bridge: Residual is net income plus the disclosed noncash adjustments and operating-asset/liability changes less reported operating cash flow. Other means the row in operating cash adjustments, not other investing or financing activities.
definitions.segment_model: Family of Apps and Reality Labs are separate segment keys, with operating margin in percent.

evidence_policy: Cite sufficient facts and relevant period, unit, definition or scope context for each output. Additional unrelated sections fail evidence. Equivalent reviewed source paths are accepted, without a shortest-citation requirement.
reconciliation_policy: Residuals compare independently supplied observations. Synthetic controls may make reported totals and components disagree. Preserve the discrepancy instead of forcing zero or changing a source observation. Algebraic identity residuals are not requested.
